maintenance_led.reason: Larger VITAS segment provides hospice care to patients; Roto-Rooter plumbing repair is the smaller part, so most revenue isn't maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: VITAS hospice, the larger segment, is paid mainly by Medicare and Medicaid; Roto-Rooter plumbing is privately paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through VITAS hospice and Roto-Rooter services; only twelve significant acquisitions or divestitures since inception.

mission_critical.reason: VITAS hospice patients can choose other hospice providers; Roto-Rooter plumbing is easily switched. Hospice is regulated but switchable.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call, since hospice care is regulated and sensitive, but switching providers is feasible.
